San Francisco, California · eat

Restaurants in San Francisco for cyclists

Where to eat in San Francisco the night before and the afternoon after. Real food, open when you need it.

Restaurants in San Francisco for cyclists, listed

  1. Woodlands Market Tiburon

    • Deli
    • 1550 Tiburon Blvd, Tiburon, CA 94920

    Nearby ride: Different Spokes Jersey Ride (2nd Saturday of the month, 8:45 am) →

    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Woodlands Market Tiburon

    After the ride, in Zone 1: a market in Tiburon with a deli counter of hot and cold sandwiches, where Different Spokes’ Jersey Ride (2nd Saturday of the month, 8:45 am) had its group lunch in May 2025, and the lunch stop of the Tiburon loop. 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, per its site and the Tiburon chamber. Seating and bike parking weren’t on any page.

  2. Original Joe’s North Beach

    The night before, in Zone 6: North Beach, on the bridge side of the city, a few blocks from Columbus Cyclery.

    • Italian-American
    • 601 Union Street, San Francisco, CA 94133
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Original Joe’s North Beach

    Dinner from 4 Monday to Thursday, lunch from 11:30 Friday and 11 on weekends; it closes at 10, or 9 on Sunday, per its site. Book on its site; the walk-in and group policy wasn’t on the page.

  3. El Farolito

    Late, and the night before, in Zone 6: burritos in the Mission, at the original shop, which its site says is open past 3 a.m. most nights.

    • Mexican
    • 2779 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about El Farolito

    Cash only, and cheap. Seating and bike parking weren’t on the page.

  4. Alice’s Restaurant

    On the way, in Zone 4: the restaurant on Skyline Boulevard in the redwoods above Woodside, at the top of the Old La Honda and Kings Mountain loop.

    • American
    • 17288 Skyline Boulevard, Woodside, CA 94062
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Alice’s Restaurant

    A stop for motorcyclists and bike teams. 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., to 7 on Sunday, per its site, with tables outside in its photos. (650) 851-0303.
